![Why Does Hair Turn Gray & How To Prevent It | Hairfix Mexico](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10122211-2787-0139-0000-30c47b063406:4)
Hair turns gray when specialized cells in your hair follicles stop producing **melanin** , the pigment that gives hair its color. As these pigment-producing cells—called **melanocytes** —gradually die off or lose stem cell support over repeated hair growth cycles, new hair grows in clear, silver, or white instead of its natural shade.[[1]](https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/hair-scalp-care/hair/gray-hair-causes)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greying_of_hair)

- **Natural Aging:** As part of the normal aging process, your body naturally slows down and stops melanin production.
- **Genetics:** Your family history is the biggest factor in **when** you start going gray and how fast it happens.
- **Oxidative Stress:** A buildup of free radicals and hydrogen peroxide inside hair follicles can damage melanocytes over time.
- **Lifestyle Factors:** Habits like **smoking** accelerate cell damage and early graying.
- **Nutritional Gaps:** Low levels of **vitamin B12** , iron, or copper can sometimes trigger premature graying.
- **Underlying Health Conditions:** Autoimmune and thyroid disorders (such as vitiligo or hypothyroidism) can disrupt pigment production.[[1]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/blog/hair-turn-gray-2017091812226)[[2]](https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/hair-scalp-care/hair/gray-hair-causes)[[3]](https://news.miami.edu/stories/2024/09/why-do-we-go-gray.html)[[4]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12182098/)[[5]](https://nutritionfacts.org/video/why-does-hair-turn-gray/)[[6]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/gray-hair)[[7]](https://www.henryford.com/blog/2025/10/why-does-hair-turn-gray)

You can read more about the biological timeline and details on the [American Academy of Dermatology](https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/hair-scalp-care/hair/gray-hair-causes) or [Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/blog/hair-turn-gray-2017091812226).[[1]](https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/hair-scalp-care/hair/gray-hair-causes)[[2]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/blog/hair-turn-gray-2017091812226)If you noticed premature graying, would you like to know more about **dietary changes**, **stress management** , or **medical causes** linked to it?
